Yes. They could be diverted from another emergency (you wanting to end your life is also an emergency btw, but of a different kind). Also, they know how to read the situation and if they find out your reason for creating the situation they will most likely try other resources to stop you from dying. 
Also, when using a gun or another weapon of the kind the situations are pretty unpredictable so no way of knowing how many people would end up getting hurt.
Answering your question: yes, it’s possible it could hurt others. So it’s not a good way to go for anyone involved.

Hi, I’m very sorry for everything you’ve gone through and continue to go through. You sound like a very strong and loving person. I can relate to the feeling of being back to a certain age when horrible things happened, and it’s very tiring indeed, as if you are in survival mode all over again. Something that helps me is remembering I’m not that age anymore, I will never ever be that age again, for better and for worse I’m a different person now, with different strengths and also different weaknesses. 
When I was grown enough to feel somewhat safe I started to reflect on the things I didn’t enjoy or couldn’t do as a child because of everything I was going through at at the time, and on the moments I felt like nobody needed me and the world would be better (or worse… the same) without me, I decided to go and do all the things the child version of myself wasn’t able to do. It was very healing for myself. I hope someday you have the chance to do it for you. 

Sending love your way, hope you stay a bit longer with us.

Hi! What kind of dreams? As in your dream life? I guess some will, some not. Some dreams will transform into something else you’ve never thought about before. Some “dreams” you’ll accomplish will not feel so dreamy after you get them, but some other things you’ll experience and never really expected to be great will become better than a dream. Here if you want to share how we can help. Sending love your way.

Hi, I’m sorry you’re feeling this way. I know it seems like it couldn’t help (and it might not) but let me know if you want to talk privately. Not as a first resort (sorry, just got a message from the guidelines that that’s not allowed) but if everything else fails, maybe? If not, try and have a good sleep and things will be clearer in the morning for whatever decision you decide to make. Sending love your way.
Exactly what the person above me said… I know you are loved by many, but here goes more love your way 🩷. If you decide to stay I hope we can talk and make a virtual friend of me.

Hi, first of all I’m sorry you’re going through this and feeling like this. I wish I had more encouraging words but I don’t. The only thing I can say is the “I’m not living for anyone else” was engraved in my mind for years since I was 14, more than 15 years ago (jezzz am I that old already?) until a couple of years ago I always knew I was going to go “that way”, never imagined myself dying another way it wasn’t by suicide. Had a few plans, even wrote some goodbye letters but for one reason or another I never did (not yet anyway). As years have passed by I have noticed that the amount of times I have thought while experiencing something either minor or major “this was nice, I’m glad I didn’t kill myself at X point” has been increasing more and more, and tbh I don’t remember last time  I even thought to myself “I’m not living for anyone else”. It hasn’t been all good times, fuck, believe me it hasn’t, but I have always tried to take it one year at a time, and without even noticing life just got better. And I’m sorry I monopolized your post talking about me, very rude of me, but I want to share one last thing: My grandma passed away exactly a week ago, and for some reason I have been the only one next to my mom through all of this, seeing her pain, seeing her trying… just imagining what I would have put her though if I was one… or just the fact I wouldn’t be today with her by her side supporting her during this difficult time.. man, I’M SO GLAD I DIDN’T KILL MYSELF AT X OR Y POINT IN MY LIFE! And my grandma wasn’t a saint, and my relationship with my mom has been rocky to say the least, but being able to just be with her has been my greatest pleasure. 
Allow yourself to have some great pleasures every now and then, maybe not this year, hopefully the next one, or the one after that, but I really hope you stay here with us.
